summary: The power to absorb kinetic energy to improve the bodily functions. Sub-power of Kinetic Energy Absorption. Variation of Energized Body.

name: Kinetic-Heat Conversion
summary: The power to convert kinetic energy into heat. Variation of Energetic Heating.

name: Knowledge Absorption
summary: The power to absorb knowledge. Sub-power of Knowledge Manipulation. Variation of Absorption. Opposite to Knowledge Projection.

name: Laser Absorption
summary: The ability to absorb lasers and utilize them in some way. Technique of Laser Manipulation. Variation of Light Absorption. Not to be confused Laser Immunity.

name: Leech Regeneration
summary: The power to regenerate wounds by absorbing leeches. Technique of Leech Manipulation. Variation of Worm Regeneration.

name: Life Absorption
summary: The power to absorb life itself and utilize it in someway. Sub-power of Life Connection. Variation of Absorption. Not to be confused with Life-Force Absorption. Opposite to Death Absorption.

name: Life-Force Conversion
summary: The power to convert life energy into another form of matter/energy. Sub-power of Life-Force Manipulation and Life-Force Absorption. Variation of Energy Conversion. Not to be confused with Life Conversion.

name: Light Capacitor
summary: The power to absorb and store light for later use. Sub-power of Light Absorption. Variation of Capacitor

name: Light Conversion
summary: The power to absorb light and convert it into other forms of energy. Sub-power of Light Manipulation and Light Absorption. Variation of Energy Conversion. Opposite of Darkness Conversion and Light Transmutation.

name: Lightning Absorption
summary: The power to absorb lightning. Sub-power of Lightning Manipulation and Electricity Absorption.

name: Linguistic Assimilation
summary: The ability to learn any language through physical contact. Sub-power of Biological Absorption and Omnilingualism.

name: Love Absorption
summary: The ability to absorb love and utilize it in some way. Sub-power of Love Manipulation. Variation of Emotion Absorption. Opposite to Hatred Absorption.

name: Luck Absorption
summary: The power to absorb luck and utilize it in some way. Sub-power of Probability Manipulation. Variation of Absorption and Luck. Opposite to Jinx Absorption.

name: Magic Conversion
summary: The power to absorb matter/energy and convert into magic power. Sub-power of Magic and Magical Energy Manipulation. Variation of Energy Conversion and Energy Transmutation.

name: Magic Metabolization
summary: The power to feed on magical energy. Sub-power of Magical Energy Absorption and Magic Empowerment. Variation of Metabolization.

name: Malevorous
summary: The ability to feed on the darkness of people's hearts and become better physically. Variation to Metabolization. Opposite to Benevorous. Not to be confused with Evil Empowerment and Sin Eating.

name: Mana Draining Field Projection
summary: The power to project a field that drains mana. Sub-power of Mana Manipulation. Variation of Draining Field Projection.

name: Mass Absorption
summary: The ability to absorb physical mass and utilize it in some way. Sub-power of Matter Absorption and Mass Manipulation. Variation of Absorption.

name: Mass Regeneration
summary: The power to transfer and repurpose bodies of mass for physical restoration. Combination of Absorbing Regeneration and Mass Transference. Sub-power of Mass Manipulation. Technique of Bodily Mass Manipulation. Not to be confused with Mass Absorption.

name: Matter Absorption
summary: The power to absorb matter and utilize it in some way. Sub-power of Matter Manipulation. Variation of Absorption. The opposite of Antimatter Absorption.

name: Meat Assimilation
summary: The ability to assimilate meat into one's body. Sub-power of Meat Manipulation. Variation of Absorption.

name: Memory Absorption
summary: The power to absorb memories and utilize them in some way. Sub-power of Memory Manipulation. Variation of Absorption.

name: Memory Vampirism
summary: The power to feed off the memories of others in order to sustain oneself. Variation of Psychic Vampirism.

name: Mental Assimilation
summary: The power to assimilate and be composed by multiple minds all fuse into one. Variation of Unimind.

name: Meta Space-Time Absorption
summary: The power to absorb all space and time and utilize them in some way. Ultimate version of Space-Time Absorption.

name: Metabolization
summary: The power to feed off anything/everything. Sub-power of Absorption and Affinity.

name: Metamorphic Conversion
summary: The power to use elements from one's being to manipulate subjects. Combination of Shiftmorphing and Life-Force Conversion.
